onboarding.title: Welcome to xopc
onboarding.subtitle: A personal assistant that learns how you work and helps carry things through.
onboarding.step0Subtitle: This helps the assistant address you naturally throughout your conversations.
onboarding.step1Subtitle: Pick a service to power your assistant. We'll choose a recommended model for you.
onboarding.step2Subtitle: Connect the service securely. You can change advanced model settings later.
onboarding.skipSetup: Skip — I'll set this up later

workDiscovery.title: Connect your recent work
workDiscovery.projectStartFailed: Could not open a conversation in this project.
workDiscovery.subtitle: Choose the read-only sources xopc may use to understand your current work and longer-term context.
workDiscovery.localSourcesSubtitle: Only selected read-only sources are collected. Content is analyzed by your configured model; xopc stores grants, evidence summaries, and derived understanding—not the imported source content.
workDiscovery.quickScanNote: Read-only discovery checks likely work folders, then asks which folders receive deeper analysis. Selected personal sources request permission separately. Relevant excerpts may be sent to your configured AI model; raw personal-source content is not stored. Passwords, secrets, chats, and browser history are excluded.
workDiscovery.noCandidates: No accessible work projects were found. You can choose a work folder instead.
workDiscovery.candidatesSubtitle: Folders are ranked by recent activity and project signals. The recommended folder is selected, and you can choose more.
workDiscovery.multiFolderPrivacyNote: Each folder is authorized and analyzed separately, in order, with its own project and session. File content from different folders is never mixed into one analysis.
workDiscovery.folderAnalysisFailed: Could not analyze {{folder}}: {{error}}. Continuing with the other selected folders.
workDiscovery.readOnlyNote: Files will not be changed. You can review the read scope before analysis starts.
workDiscovery.selectedSubtitle: xopc will inspect project structure, project instructions, recent text changes, and Git state.
workDiscovery.willReadValue: Project structure, instructions, recent text files, and Git state
workDiscovery.willIgnoreValue: Dependencies, build output, binary files, and common secret files
workDiscovery.providerDisclosure: Relevant text excerpts may be sent to {{provider}} for analysis. Raw credentials and excluded files are not included.
workDiscovery.localDisclosure: Analysis uses the configured local model. Excluded files are not included.
workDiscovery.analyzingSubtitle: You can return to chat while the analysis continues in the background.
workDiscovery.continueInBackground: Continue in background and return to chat
workDiscovery.recognitionTitle: Does this match what you're working on?
workDiscovery.profileCandidatesSubtitle: Only selected statements become usable understanding. You can edit or remove them later in About You.
workDiscovery.workThreadsSubtitle: These separate today's focus from work that appears to be continuing over time.
workDiscovery.correctionPlaceholder: For example: Today I want to finish the onboarding flow, not the user profile settings.
workDiscovery.focusDescription: Add this as a focus and enable read-only progress monitoring. xopc only surfaces meaningful changes.
workDiscovery.focusActiveDescription: This is now a first-class focus. You can inspect, pause, complete, or remove it from Work.
workDiscovery.riskCommand: May run a command with approval
workDiscovery.lowConfidenceTitle: A little more context will help
